exact_missing_items: corroboration_request packet: claim/issue under test, target scope, why corroboration was triggered, evidence set/source refs, required quorum model, participating actor refs
corroboration_result: participant outputs, quorum result, accepted/not-accepted/advisory-only result, resulting concern/promotion/patch implications
current: projection up to date for normal read + write interaction
refreshing: slightly behind but actively catching up; read fine, write may be fine depending on object class
stale: data old enough that mutation-bearing actions should narrow or require refetch
degraded: projector or dependency failure; surface may be incomplete or partially wrong
unavailable: projection cannot support that surface; UI must fall back or disable
do-not-forget: selected_repo_id already exists in storage planning; gap is now in UI contract adoption
GitHub_Integration.md must adopt selected_repo_id from storage-plan.md rather than treating it as a future undefined key
Deferred GitHub Recovery Binding must be wired to the canonical blocked-episode / concern record path, not to a UI-local heuristic
graph_patch_request: patch point, triggering issue/concern refs, requested structural change summary, affected generation, requester identity
graph_patch_result: old generation, new generation, invalidated path refs, new path refs, surviving/rejoined path refs, resulting concern/promotion/recovery implications
historical: queryable past object/state that is no longer the currently active focus
stale_historical: historical and explicitly not resumable/reusable for live execution
superseded: replaced by a newer canonical successor in the same lineage
revoked: previously accepted/promoted/active decision or state explicitly withdrawn
reopened: previously closed/accepted path returned to active question or work
archived: intentionally retained but removed from default active presentation
removed: live backing removed while historical identity may still persist
projection trust states: current, refreshing, stale, degraded, unavailable
current: projection is caught up enough for normal use
refreshing: old committed projection still visible while refresh/rebuild runs
stale: projection is usable for context but may not reflect current runtime truth
degraded: projector/scan partially failed or a dependency signal is missing; some fields/sections are less trustworthy
unavailable: projection cannot currently answer the surface contract
receipt records (orchestrator.receipt.{run_id}.{attempt_id}) must carry project_id and created_at_utc as required fields to enable cross-surface pivoting
The early storage-plan receipt value shape that omits these fields must be updated to match the later cross-surface record definition
This is an internal contradiction within storage-plan.md — the later definition must win
